cohort: The study included 40 extremely preterm infants with BPD-PH (cases) matched with 40 infants with BPD alone (controls), born between 2018 and 2020 at the University of Alabama at Birmingham.
finding: Longer duration of intermittent hypoxemic events, particularly below 70% oxygen saturation, was significantly associated with both a diagnosis of BPD-PH and with death among infants with BPD-PH.
